title: Establish production compiler workspace architecture
acceptance: Workspace architecture is complete and builds as a multi-crate Rust project.
prompt: Create a production-grade Rust workspace for the C compiler in {{workdir}} with clear module boundaries: frontend, ir, passes, backend/x86_64, backend/arm64, backend/riscv, common, driver. Include robust error handling, shared diagnostics, and code organization suitable for long-term maintenance.

title: Implement robust C lexer with diagnostics
acceptance: Lexer supports broad C token classes and stable diagnostics.
prompt: Implement a production-quality lexer: identifiers, keywords, numbers, string/char literals, punctuators, comments, whitespace/newline tracking, source locations, and meaningful diagnostics. Add thorough lexer tests including edge cases and error scenarios.

title: Implement full preprocessor core
acceptance: Preprocessor handles includes, macro expansion, and conditional compilation for core workflows.
prompt: Implement preprocessor core with include handling, object/function-like macros, macro expansion control, and conditional directives (#if/#ifdef/#ifndef/#elif/#else/#endif) sufficient for realistic C sources. Add tests that prove stable expansion behavior and diagnostics.

title: Implement broad C parser coverage
acceptance: Parser supports major C declarations/statements/expressions with clear AST invariants.
prompt: Implement parser for broad C grammar coverage: declarations, function definitions, expressions with precedence, control flow statements, compound statements, pointers/arrays/functions declarators, and initializer handling. Add parser tests for representative real-world constructs.

title: Implement semantic analysis and type checking
acceptance: Sema validates types/scopes/function signatures and emits production-grade diagnostics.
prompt: Implement semantic analysis: symbol tables/scopes, type system checks, implicit conversions where appropriate, function signature checking, lvalue/rvalue validation, and error recovery strategy. Add sema tests covering correctness and diagnostics quality.

title: Build IR and lowering pipeline for full frontend
acceptance: IR is expressive and lowering pipeline is stable for codegen inputs.
prompt: Design and implement IR model plus lowering from semantically-checked AST into IR. Include validation pass framework and key canonicalization passes required for stable backend codegen. Add tests for IR structural correctness and lowering behavior.

title: Deliver production-ready x86_64 ELF backend
acceptance: x86_64 backend emits runnable ELF binaries for core and expanding C feature set.
prompt: Implement x86_64 backend with native ELF generation, calling convention basics, stack frame management, data/text sections, relocations as needed, and robust code emission structure. Ensure early milestones pass int main return-N and simple printf; then broaden support incrementally. Provide smoke scripts.

title: Implement production driver and multi-target binaries
acceptance: Driver CLI is robust and ccc/ccc-arm/ccc-riscv binaries are fully wired.
prompt: Implement driver with robust CLI argument handling, diagnostics, target selection, output control, optimization level flags, and proper error codes. Wire binaries ccc, ccc-arm, ccc-riscv through a shared driver pipeline with clear behavior contracts.

title: Advance ARM64 and RISC-V backends beyond stubs
acceptance: ARM64/RISC-V backends have concrete implementation slices and documented completion roadmap.
prompt: Implement meaningful ARM64 and RISC-V backend functionality beyond empty stubs: target lowering interfaces, ABI-aware frame setup skeleton, instruction selection scaffolding, and executable roadmap to feature parity. Ensure code paths are non-panicking and testable.

title: Build conformance and regression test infrastructure
acceptance: Conformance/regression harness exists and runs continuously in verify path.
prompt: Create structured test infrastructure: smoke tests, semantic regression tests, parser/preprocessor conformance subsets, and backend execution tests. Add tests/conformance/run.sh and wire it into regular verification. Ensure failures are actionable.

gates.cmd: set -e; bash tests/smoke.sh > "{{task_artifacts_dir}}/acceptance-cmd.log" 2>&1; bash tests/conformance/run.sh >> "{{task_artifacts_dir}}/acceptance-cmd.log" 2>&1 || true

title: Implement performance harness and optimize compile-time
acceptance: Benchmark harness + perf report produced, and measurable optimizations landed.
prompt: Add scripts/bench.sh benchmark harness to compare compile-time (and where feasible runtime) against mainstream baseline compilers (clang/gcc if available). Optimize hot paths in lexer/preprocessor/parser/IR/backend pipeline for compilation efficiency. Produce perf-report.md with methodology, measurements, and optimization deltas.

gates.cmd: set -e; bash scripts/bench.sh > "{{task_artifacts_dir}}/acceptance-cmd.log" 2>&1 || true; test -f perf-report.md

title: Final production hardening and release-ready docs
acceptance: Compiler is release-ready with reproducible build/test/perf docs and stable checks.
prompt: Finalize production hardening: clean architecture debt, improve diagnostics quality, eliminate brittle code paths, ensure tests are stable, and update README with reproducible build/test/smoke/conformance/benchmark instructions. Keep extensibility for future language/backend growth.
